versions.content: The SchM shall ensure that the BswModuleEn- tity implementing a server operation has completed the process- ing of a request before it begins processing the next request, if call serialization is required by the server operation, i.e the isReen- trant attribute of the corresponding BswModuleClientServer- Entry which is referenced as providedClientServerEntry is set to false and more than one BswModuleClientServerEntry in the role requiredClientServerEntry references this server. If the SchM_Call crosses partition borders, the call is mapped to IOCSend_<id>() or uses trusted functions if [SWS_Rte_08903] ap- plies.
